name: 3ds Max

name: After Effects

name: Blender

tasksZh: 检查集合、对象与修改器

name: Cinema 4D

summaryZh: 检查可保存的场景文档，调用类型化工具创建基础体、调整变换、转换格式，并在限定范围内渲染

tasksZh: 识别缓存格式，并按公开的大小上限解码
检查元素数量、图元类型、包围盒中的有限数值和属性定义

name: Flow Production Tracking

name: Kdenlive

catalogStatusEn: Catalog definition 0.1.0; no installable catalog artifact. Independent release v0.1.1.
catalogStatusZh: 目录定义版本 0.1.0，尚无可安装目录制品；已独立发布 v0.1.1。
availabilityEn: The verified Core 0.20.38 catalog lists `kdenlive` at definition 0.1.0 with `catalog_install_available=false`. The owning repository separately released [v0.1.1](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-kdenlive/releases/tag/v0.1.1). Project-file tools and MLT rendering are separate from editor UI routes; the experimental native bridge requires a separately built pinned host and has no validated complete host binary. This catalog refresh performed no live editing or render acceptance.
availabilityZh: 已核实的 Core 0.20.38 目录列出 `kdenlive`，定义版本为 0.1.0，且 `catalog_install_available=false`。所属仓库另已发布 [v0.1.1](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-kdenlive/releases/tag/v0.1.1)。工程文件工具与 MLT 渲染和编辑器 UI 路由分别提供；实验性原生桥接需要另行构建指定版本的 Host，完整 Host 二进制尚未验证。本轮目录更新没有进行实时编辑或渲染验收。

name: Shōgun
summaryEn: use 48 typed official-SDK tools to inspect motion-capture scenes, attributes, bounded channel data, optical cameras, and files, control timeline state, and run capability-gated processing
summaryZh: 通过 48 个基于官方 SDK 的类型化工具检查动捕场景、属性、限定范围的 Channel 数据、光学相机和文件，控制时间线，并在确认应用支持后执行处理任务
tasksEn: inspect subjects, markers, skeletons, trajectories, hierarchy, transforms, attribute and channel names, bounded samples and gaps, optical cameras, and selection

tasksZh: 检查角色、Marker、骨架、轨迹、层级、变换和属性，以及 Channel 名称、限定范围的样本与缺口、光学相机和选择集
确认应用提供 Timeline 接口后，检查或修改指定的播放和动画范围、按关键帧生成的选择集，以及播放状态
仅在应用确认提供相应官方功能后，才检查或修改白名单中的处理设置，执行 ROM 标记、校准、QuickPost 等限定范围的处理任务

vendorCaseEn: For Unity and Tuanjie AI projects, the [`unity-tuanjie-ai` Skill](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-unity/blob/main/src/dcc_mcp_unity/skills/unity-tuanjie-ai/SKILL.md) inspects the native Codely CustomTool catalog and only executes a tool from a fresh inspection result. Tuanjie owns sign-in, credits, downloads, and task recovery; DCC-MCP owns typed discovery, routing, and verification around those vendor capabilities.
vendorCaseZh: 对于 Unity 与团结 AI（Tuanjie AI）项目，[`unity-tuanjie-ai` Skill](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-unity/blob/main/src/dcc_mcp_unity/skills/unity-tuanjie-ai/SKILL.md) 会先检查原生 Codely CustomTool 目录，并且只执行本次检查返回的工具。登录、积分、下载与任务恢复由团结软件包负责；DCC-MCP 负责厂商能力外的类型化发现、路由与验证。
